value.zh-Hant: 立陶宛政治家、哲學博士，基督教民主黨領袖；1925年9月至1926年5月任總理，兼國防與外交部長，並曾任國會議長。
value.en: Lithuanian politician and philosophy doctor, leader of the Christian Democrats; prime minister from September 1925 to May 1926, also defence and foreign minister, and earlier Seimas speaker.
